scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dip --only firestore,storage "node --import tsx --test gcp/tests/rules/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:swift: swift test --package-path ui/Packages/DIPContracts && swift test --package-path ui/Packages/DIPDesignSystem && swift test --package-path ui/Packages/DIPAccounts && swift test --package-path ui/Packages/DIPCore
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run test:sessions && npm run test:docs && npm run test:contracts && npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:seed: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dip --only auth,firestore "node gcp/scripts/seed.mjs && node gcp/scripts/seed.mjs"
scripts.test:sessions: python3 scripts/session-log.py check --self-test && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.test:accounts:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-dip --only auth,functions,firestore "node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 gcp/tests/integration/accounts*.test.ts"
